2: Established in 2007, Penlucky today is one of the Chinese leading manufacturers of the highest quality diesel generating sets and complete power generation systems. We have a wide power range from 9kVA to 3450kVA with world famous engine and alternator brand.

Penlucky Power is located in Weifang High-Tech Zone, Shandong, China, founded in 2007, specializing in the design, manufacture, and sales of mobile lighting towers, standby generator sets, and continuous operation power stations.
